notes: Dev ABox revision on capital_of (Aztec Empire to Inca Empire for Tenochtitlan). The original, 'the Aztec Templo Mayor', is stored. Risk, recorded: 'Aztec' names the temple's builders and culture, and a model may answer the Aztec Empire from that attribution; but a model holding the temple in Tenochtitlan and Tenochtitlan in the Inca Empire while putting the temple in the Aztec Empire is inconsistent, so the query stays determinate. The derived queries avoid every fact stored about Tenochtitlan by name (earlier questions on Cortés, 1519 and Nahuatl were dropped because they are stored about the city itself). Two compositions name the Inca Empire as 'the empire whose capital was Tenochtitlan' and ask facts stored about the empire only (Machu Picchu; its main language). The third applies the empire's class rule to its new capital (inheritance: was Tenochtitlan ruled by the Inca emperor; no, then yes). The related question is the stored 'built on the ruins of the Aztec capital' (72 and 125 hits), changed through one bridge (Mexico City was built on the ruins of Tenochtitlan). The Templo Mayor prompt says 'ancient Aztec city' and the Inca emperor check asks whether the emperor ruled the whole empire, after audit failures on the earlier wording. No query uses transitivity.
